about: Gap-closing programs. Status lines re-checked on each program's own page on 2026-11-07 (one fetch each). FUNDS ARE UNCONFIRMED: a program page saying 'up to $X' does not mean money is available now. Never show a program as available without the status.

programs.name: CalHome (HCD)
programs.who_applies: Local public agencies and nonprofits; HCD page: 'CalHOME does not lend directly to individuals'
programs.what: First-time buyer mortgage assistance, ADU/JADU help, homeownership development loans
programs.status: CLOSED: page says 'No longer accepting applications' (part of the Homeownership Super NOFA). Next round date UNKNOWN. Checked 2026-11-07

programs.name: CalHFA MyHome Assistance
programs.what: Deferred junior loan for down payment / closing costs
programs.max: lesser of 3.5% of price or appraised value (CalHFA FHA) or 3% (CalHFA conventional); no dollar cap stated
programs.status: Listed on CalHFA page; funds availability not stated. Stacking with a nonprofit first mortgage: UNKNOWN. Checked 2026-11-07

programs.name: CalHFA Dream For All
programs.who_applies: First-time buyer, voucher by randomized drawing
programs.max: up to 20%, not to exceed $150,000 (CalHFA page)
programs.status: CLOSED: voucher application period closed (portal closed after Mar 16, 2026). Next round UNKNOWN. Checked 2026-11-07

programs.name: CalHFA ADU Grant
programs.what: Reimburses ADU pre-development and non-recurring closing costs
programs.max: up to $40,000 (CalHFA and HCD pages agree)
programs.status: NOT AVAILABLE as far as we can tell: CalHFA page says 'The latest round of ADU funding has been fully allocated' (Dec 28, 2023); no newer round posted. Checked 2026-11-07
